envelope.note: option B: single board tier, 15.65 mm

SH1.what: split-ring electrostatic shield (rf2_shield_pcb.py): open rings + one radial spine, single-point ground

QA.what: SB1R-QA quadrupole receive board, copper unchanged; outline variant without the r 116 tab (does not fit a 2 mm wall)

QB.what: SB1R-QB (QA turned 45 deg), copper unchanged; same outline variant

stack_pins.what: 2 PETG pins from the skid through SH1 / QA / QB (the SB1R NPTH holes); the 22.5 deg hole carries the shield's ground wire up (SH1 plated pad there)

coil.what: rim mono, 5 rows x 6 columns (option B), wound column by column down-and-up (owner's progressive order: 166 V max between neighbours)

walls.note: 89: analog | digital, PETG loaded with carbonyl iron; 156: analog | HV; 198: HV | digital; 156 has an LV slot for MP1's output flex

AB1A.what: RF1 AB1A analog section (D40, 6-layer rigid with the 2-layer flex core), routed in RF1: 0 open, KiCad DRC clean; mounted COMPONENT SIDE UP (its parts are on one side, 2.15 mm tall, measured on the RF1 mesh: they would hit the bay floor facing down)

AB1B.what: RF1 AB1B analog section, routed in RF1

CB1D.what: RF1 CB1D section: RP2354A, LMR36015 buck, TLV755P (placed in RF1; route next); option B: on the AB1 tier, parts below 2.0 / above 4.4

MP1.what: NEW mono preamp: HV-tolerant input (630 V parts, >= 1.0 mm), output to AB1A; option B: 3 mm inward (the 6-column channel wall is at r 103.8)

TXJ.what: NEW coil-lead terminal board: wire-hole pads (Wire_pads) for the coil leads and the shaft TX pair; option B: at (-94.5, 0), between MP1 and the channel wall (r 103.8)

LED.what: LED display: FLEX section of the rigid-flex panel (0.2 mm polyimide on a 0.2 mm FR4 stiffener), 522 SK9822-EC20 in 13 rings from r 104 to the centre (rf2_ledgrid.py), clocked, dark during receive windows and power-gated when silent

lid_light.material: clear / natural PETG, printed solid (diffuser; transmission ASSUMED)
lid_light.note: no holes over the LEDs: 522 windows would weaken the lid and the seal

gland.what: shaft cable enters DOWN through the lid at the heel into the HV sector

potting.coil: syntactic foam (resin + glass bubbles, eps about 1.8 UNVERIFIED): lowest winding capacitance (rf2_zones: gate 15.96 us)
potting.hv: MG 832TC epoxy (48 kV breakdown at 3.2 mm; kept >= 3 mm from the winding: eps 3.7, DF 0.1)

ref_coil.place: on the shaft, 0.6 m from the head
ref_coil.former: 3 orthogonal windings, 100 mm, on a PETG frame
ref_coil.requirement: area-turns = 3 x the mono per axis (rf2_emi.py)
ref_coil.noise: 2.0 nV/rtHz, depth cost 1.4 %, copper 104 g (rf2_ref3.py; the earlier 620 x 0.15 mm on 80 mm gave 2.32 nV/rtHz and 1.8 %)

netlist_variant_note: rf2_netlist.BOARDS MP1 / TXJ 'head' positions are option A's; the option-B board builds take MP1 (-72, 3) and TXJ (-94.5, 0) (stage 4)

materials.coil_wire: FEP-insulated litz (rf2_qualify section D; DATASHEET_LOG RF2-DS-FEP): FEP eps 2.1 (Gund note, a supplier technical note, not a grade datasheet), 200 C, no creep; finished OD 1.2 mm is ASSUMED, so the vendor OD, strand count and wall thickness must be confirmed before the combs are printed
materials.sleeves: FEP on every wire in the head that leaves the coil's 1.2 mm litz: FEP-jacketed hookup wire for the shaft HV pair and the sense wires, FEP tubing over the litz lead pair to the TXJ board (same eps 2.1 and no creep; PTFE rejected: it creeps). Voltage rating of the finished wire is UNVERIFIED: must be >= 630 V (rule 6)
materials.coating: Parylene (SCS ParyFree, falling back to Parylene C) on the analog and near-coil fins: moisture and leakage barrier with no magnetic or eddy effect
materials.coil_potting: syntactic foam (K1 glass bubbles in silicone, eps about 1.75-1.9): coil capacitance 101 pF with FEP litz (rf2_qualify D)
materials.status: MODELED / sourced from supplier notes; not bench-tested

coil_combs.what: printed winding combs (resin print): radial plates with one slot per groove column (1.3 mm slots for the 1.2 mm litz, 0.3 mm teeth), the turns laid from the top, column by column

shield_coat.material: MG 841AR nickel coating, 25 um (1.6 ohm/sq): echo tau 1 ns (rf2_zones)
shield_coat.what: electrostatic screen on the shell's inner face, joined to SH1 at the stack-pin ground; one 2 mm slit

zone_rules: no solid copper planes; hatched 1.0 / 0.25 mm with every border slit (rf2_zones: closed border up to 3300 x noise)
no aluminium electrolytic or other metal-can parts in the head: MLCC only (can echo 2e4-7.5e4 x noise)
nothing switches in the receive window; analog / TXJ loops < 0.1 cm2, edge-on where the field is vertical
IXTY08N100D2 tab edge-on to the field or a tab-less package (tab echo 2700 x noise, tau 19.8 us)
